title: Base guarded trader (plain TypeScript)
summary: Reads Base market data (block, gas, Chainlink ETH/USD), decides with a small Model interface, and runs every intent through the Sato Kit: quote, prepare, simulate and a policy pre-flight that names the rule, limit and observed value of every refusal. Fixture mode needs no network and no key. It signs only on a local fork with a throwaway key or on Base Sepolia with a managed wallet, and never on mainnet.

tests.description: The platform runs the fixture command over the shipped recordings (no network, no key) and checks out/report.json against schemas/output.json: exit 0, and the over-cap intent refused with its rule, limit and observed value.
The template's own tests. Recorded, never the verdict.
Nightly in satohubai/sato-agent-templates: an anvil fork of Base at block 51800000 with recorded quotes; exact reads, an approve simulation and pre-flight outcomes. Never broadcasts.

provenance.notes: Deterministic over fixtures. Fork and testnet modes are opt-in and never run in the platform's offline test phase.
